items.question: When are Claude's peak hours?
items.answer: Claude's peak hours are weekdays from 13:00 to 19:00 UTC. Weekday evenings, nights and the whole weekend are off-peak.

items.question: What happens during peak hours?
items.answer: Your 5-hour session limit drains faster than usual on Free, Pro, Max and Team plans. Weekly limits don't change.

items.question: Is Claude in peak hours right now?
items.answer: The live clock at the top of this page shows the current status in your time zone and counts down to the next change. Developers can check it with GET /api/status.

items.question: Which Claude plans are affected?
items.answer: Free, Pro, Max and Team. Enterprise plans aren't affected, and Claude Code on Pro and Max has been exempt since May 6, 2026.

items.question: What changed with Claude Code limits on September 14, 2026?
items.answer: Standard Claude Code weekly limits became permanently 25% higher than the pre-promotion baseline. The temporary +50% boost ended the same day, so heavy users have about 17% less weekly capacity than during the promo.

items.question: How can I get more out of my Claude limits?
items.answer: Run long or token-heavy work outside weekday peak hours, for example in the evening or at the weekend, when session limits drain at normal speed.

items.question: What was the March 2026 Claude promotion?
items.answer: From March 13 to 27, 2026, Claude doubled session limits outside weekday peak hours and all weekend for Free, Pro, Max and Team plans.

items.question: How does PromoClock verify AI deals?
items.answer: Every deal links to an official source, such as a help center article or the company's blog, and shows the date it was last checked. Expired offers leave the live lists automatically.

items.question: Is PromoClock affiliated with Anthropic?
items.answer: No. PromoClock is an independent project by Onur Şendere. Some outbound links are affiliate links, but they never decide which deals are listed.

disclosure.metaDescription: How PromoClock uses affiliate links and how we choose which AI deals to list.
disclosure.title: Affiliate disclosure
paragraphs: PromoClock is an independent project. Some links to AI tools on this site are affiliate or partner links. If you sign up or buy through one of them, we may earn a commission at no extra cost to you.

Affiliate relationships never decide whether a deal is listed. We list offers that are publicly available from the tool's official channels, link to the original source, and show the date we last verified each one.
Promo codes are only shown when they are published by the tool or provided by its partner program. Expired offers are removed from live lists automatically.
Tools without an affiliate program — including ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude and Midjourney — are covered in exactly the same way. PromoClock is not affiliated with Anthropic or any tool listed.
Questions? Reach out on X at @onursendere.

about.title: About PromoClock
about.intro: PromoClock is an independent tracker for Claude's usage limits and for verified promotions across 50 popular AI tools.

sections.title: How we verify
sections.body: Every deal and limit change links to an official source: a help center article, an official blog post or an announcement from the company's own account. We record the date we last checked each one and only publish codes the company or its partner program provides.

sections.title: How often it updates
sections.body: The site rebuilds every day. Deal status is calculated from start and end dates, so expired offers leave the live lists automatically, and the peak-hours clock runs live in your browser.

sections.title: Who runs it
sections.body: PromoClock is built and maintained by Onur Şendere, founder of Digiwings, a one-person digital agency in Shrewsbury, UK. It is not affiliated with Anthropic or any tool listed.
